description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.9, §5.13): the giants of Harrok the Unbowed's clan at Harrok's Hall (members carry faction "harrok_clan"). Hostile to a rival giant until the champion's duel at the Moot is settled: a spared Harrok - or the talk ending, where he kneels without a fight - reconciles the clan (MootArena: FactionState.reconcile), and its giants stand down; a slain Harrok leaves it hostile for good (its giants wander the highlands: wander.stonehold's clan_giants).
reconciled_text: Harrok's clan honours your victory: its giants let you pass.
